backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining Product, Service, and Order types with sample data and query functions for filtering/sorting products by price, source, and currency, plus order creation/retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (routing, products/services pages, contact, sitemap, onboarding) to source files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON object containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files including pages, components, routing, styling, and arbitrage logic stubs.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode CSS variables for background, foreground, primary, secondary, accent, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, title 'e-Com Aggr. Services', root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router setup defining six routes (home, products, services, contact, sitemap, onboarding) with Layout wrapper and RouterProvider configuration.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Application layout with sticky header navigation, logo, route links with icons, active state styling, and footer with caffeine.ai attribution and project description.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook managing backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, automatic query invalidation on identity changes, and anonymous actor fallback.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication providing login/logout functions, identity state, login status tracking, and AuthClient configuration with derivation origin support.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a professional e-commerce color palette for both light and dark modes, including primary (teal), accent (orange), and chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/arbitrage.ts: Arbitrage engine stub implementing leaderboard-driven profit extraction logic with set_arbitrage and get_arbitrage functions; includes extensive TODOs for Stage 2/3 implementation of Merkle logging, wallet integration, and external scraping.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that sets up QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page component that fetches and displays contact information and an e-contract iframe portal using React Query and the backend actor.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page with hero section, feature cards (unlimited scraping, arbitrage engine, Merkle tracing), and development roadmap showcasing the platform's capabilities.
frontend/src/pages/Onboarding.tsx: Client registration page implementing QRC onboarding flow that generates a unique clientId from unix timestamp and 10-digit mobile number.
frontend/src/pages/Products.tsx: Products catalog page that fetches and displays aggregated products from multiple e-commerce sources with pricing, source URLs, and external links.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: React page component that fetches and displays all services from the backend using React Query, showing service cards with title, price, currency, source URL, and a link to view details. Includes loading skeletons and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/Sitemap.tsx: React page component that fetches and displays the application sitemap grouped by role, showing routes with their paths, priorities, and access levels in a table format. Includes loading states, error handling, and an alert about the machine-readable sitemap.xml endpoint.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, custom fonts (Inter, JetBrains Mono), container queries, typography plugin, and custom animations for accordions and fade-in effects.
project_state.json: Project state document tracking the e-commerce aggregator platform's staged implementation (Stage 1 complete with routes/models/mock data, Stage 2 stubbed with QRC onboarding, Stage 3 TODO with real scraping). Lists existing features including product/service pages, contact page with iframe, and sitemap generation.
